newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends higher in minimal volum.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends higher in minimal volum.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index ended slightly higher on Friday but volume continued at an extremely low level, dealers said.
Volume, which has shrunk this year, was just 46,070 shares.

Investors are staying out of the market ahead of half-year results, or have been tempted away by rates of 40-45 percent offered on Treasury bills. Deputy finance minister Victor Selormey said on Wednesday the government was considering new privatisations as a way of giving the bourse a shot in the arm.
Ashanti Goldfields fell 200 cedis to 21,600 but all other price movements were upwards.
Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH was the most active stock, adding 10 cedis to 530 on volume of 18,300 shares.
